{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Rise and shine for those green steps before the sun gets cheeky."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"A splash of blessing and calm, the water knows how to welcome you."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Terima kasih (thank you (Indonesian)) to whoever invented a lunch this fresh and easy."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The monkeys run the show here, keep your sunglasses close and your grin closer."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A quick royal peek before the evening paints the sky."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The sun won’t wait, so catch it stretching over the ridge."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Little plates, big flavour, and everyone leaves happy."}]}
